drawless.save_error: Could not save. Use Retry save to try again.
drawless.reset.title: Restore default settings?
drawless.reset.description: This resets every DrawLess setting, including experimental and diagnostic options. Your current settings will be replaced.
drawless.hint.toggle: Click or press Enter to toggle. Hover for details.
drawless.hint.choice: Left click: next. Right click: previous. Keyboard: left/right arrows.
drawless.hint.number: Drag the value left/right. Hold Shift for finer adjustment. Keyboard: left/right arrows.
drawless.unavailable.if: ImmediatelyFast manages this feature. The saved DrawLess preference is preserved.
drawless.unavailable.shader_pack: Unavailable while an Iris shader pack is active. The saved DrawLess preference is preserved.
drawless.setting.enabled.description: Master switch for rendering optimizations. You can edit preferences while DrawLess is off.
drawless.setting.display_mode.descriptio: Live geometry keeps movement and animation live. Static scene is for comparisons; live extraction is experimental.
drawless.setting.batching.description: Expanded combines more draws but can change overlapping layers. Choose Limited or Off if layers look wrong.
drawless.setting.text_reuse.description: Experimental. Reuses the current text/name-tag buffer within a preparation pass. Off by default.
drawless.setting.live_view_culling.descr: Item Displays on the GPU that are outside the camera view are skipped for the frame. Ticks and animation keep running. A part moving very quickly into view may appear a moment late.
drawless.setting.live_pose_fast_path.des: Computes the pose of interpolating Item Display parts directly instead of running them through vanilla submission every frame. A part whose pose this does not reproduce keeps the ordinary path.
drawless.setting.model_cache.description: Reuses Item Display model layers and refreshes them within a bounded CPU budget.
drawless.setting.adaptive_budget.descrip: Gradually adjusts the model refresh budget to frame cadence. Relevant when the model cache is enabled.
drawless.setting.model_budget.descriptio: CPU budget per frame, from 100 to 5000 microseconds. A larger budget permits more refresh work.
drawless.setting.particle_light.descript: Reuses base light and immutable positions. Light reuse is invalidated by ticks and world/light changes; some integrations use pass-local reuse. On by default for new settings.
drawless.setting.particle_collision.desc: Skips collision work for air or context-checked empty shapes, reusing block states within a tick. Count and movement are preserved. On by default for new settings.
drawless.setting.npc_budget.description: Experimental. Limits NPC pose refresh work and can reduce animation update frequency.
drawless.setting.npc_groups.description: Maximum pose groups refreshed per frame when the NPC pose budget is enabled.
drawless.setting.adaptive_npc.descriptio: Adjusts NPC pose work to frame cadence when the NPC pose budget is enabled.
drawless.setting.all_displays.descriptio: Applies the selected display mode to the entire Item Display scene instead of detected NPC parts only.
drawless.unavailable.particle_pipeline: Particle Core or AsyncParticles manages this pipeline. Your saved DrawLess preference is preserved.
drawless.setting.player_armor_geometry.d: Keeps player armor meshes on the GPU and sends only part poses, lighting and tint each frame. Base layers, trims and glint of a piece always use the same path; unsupported armor uses vanilla rendering.
drawless.setting.player_item_geometry.de: Keeps meshes of items held and worn on the head by players and mannequins on the GPU, shared with Item Displays, and sends only item poses, lighting and tint each frame, including enchantment glint. Glowing, translucent and specially rendered items use vanilla rendering.
drawless.setting.player_body_geometry.de: Keeps player body meshes and skins on the GPU and draws every body in one call. Only skins without semi-transparent pixels use it; other skins, invisible and glowing players keep vanilla rendering.
drawless.unavailable.player_model_mods: Unavailable with a mod that changes player models or skins. The saved DrawLess preference is preserved.
